data.prohibited_input: probabilities must not be transformed back into logits

fit.method: one positive scalar temperature per training seed
fit.input: original deterministic logits saved by the selected checkpoint
fit.objective: pooled per-second multiclass negative log likelihood

evaluation.aggregation: pool all seconds within each seed, then report three-seed mean and sample standard deviation
evaluation.reliability_diagram: two-panel raw versus temperature-scaled top-label reliability on test

metric_definitions.ece_15: sum_b (n_b/N) * abs(accuracy_b - mean_confidence_b), using 15 equal-width top-confidence bins on [0,1] with confidence=1 included in the final bin
metric_definitions.macro_f1: unweighted mean of the seven per-class F1 values with zero_division=0

separation_from_rq2.future_gate_calibration_study: separate validation-only ablation requiring threshold revalidation

test_exposure_note: The test split had been inspected during earlier iterative method development. This protocol prevents new test-informed calibration choices but cannot restore independent confirmatory status.
